data.name: Mufti
data.gender_notes: Mufti is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A mufti is a jurisconsult who is an interpreter or expounder of Islamic law. The name Mufti carries the meaning “Jurisconsult” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mufti usually hope their child will grow to embody jurisconsult and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who interprets Quran and Hadith for the betterment of society.
data.etymology: Mufti belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jurisconsult.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufti total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مفتي
in_arabic.meaning: مفتي يعني الشخص الذي يفتي في الدين ويفسر القوانين
in_arabic.long_meaning: المفتي هو الشخص الذي يتم تعيينه لإصدار الفتاوى والقرارات الدينية، وهو مسؤول عن تفسير الشريعة الإسلامية وتقديم الإرشاد الديني. يأتي المصطلح من الجذر العربي 'ف-ت-ي' والذي يعني 'الفتوى' أو 'التفسير'. في التاريخ الإسلامي، كان المفتي شخصية مهمة في تقديم الإرشاد الديني والقانوني للمجتمع.

in_urdu.name: مفتى
in_urdu.meaning: مفتى کا مطلب ہے جو فتوی دیتا ہے اور دین کی تشریح کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مفتى وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو فتاوى اور دینی احکام جاری کرنے کے لئے مقرر کیا جاتا ہے۔ وہ شریعت اسلامیہ کی تشریح کرنے اور دینی رہنمائی प्रदान کرنے کے لئے ذمہ دار ہوتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ عربی جڑ 'ف-ت-ي' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'فتوى' یا 'تشریح'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں، مفتى ایک اہم شخصیت ہے جو دینی اور قانونی رہنمائی فراہم کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुफ़्ती
in_hindi.meaning: मुफ़्ती का अर्थ है जो फतवा देता है और धर्म की व्याख्या करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुफ़्ती वह व्यक्ति होता है जिसे फतवे और धार्मिक आदेश जारी करने के लिए नियुक्त किया जाता है। वह शरीयत اسلامی की व्याख्या करने और धार्मिक मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करने के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है। यह शब्द अरबी मूल 'फ-त-य' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'फतवा' या 'व्याख्या'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, मुफ़्ती एक महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति है जो धार्मिक और कानूनी मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करता है।

in_pashto.name: مفتي
in_pashto.meaning: مفتي دى هغه چا چې فتوى ورکوي او دين تشریح کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مفتي هغه شخص دی چې د فتاوى او دينى احکامو د ورکولو لپاره ټاکل شوی دی. هغه د شريعت اسلامي د تشریح او ديني لارښوونې د تقديم لپاره مسؤل دی. دا کلمه د عربي جڑ 'ف-ت-ي' څخه اخیستل شوې ده چې معنی یې ده 'فتوى' یا 'تشریح'. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې، مفتي يو مهم شخصیت دی چې ديني او قانوني لارښوونې تقديم کوي.

in_english.name: Mufti
in_english.meaning: A Mufti is a high-ranking Islamic scholar who issues fatwas
in_english.long_meaning: A Mufti is a senior Islamic jurist and scholar who is authorized to issue fatwas (legal rulings) on matters of Islamic law and theology. The term originates from the Arabic root 'ف-ت-ي' (f-t-y), meaning 'to guide' or 'to interpret'. Throughout Islamic history, the Mufti has played a significant role in providing authoritative guidance on religious and legal matters. In contemporary times, Muftis continue to serve as respected authorities in Muslim communities worldwide, offering guidance on a range of issues from worship and personal conduct to social and political matters.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: مفتي

data.cultural_impact: A mufti holds a significant position in the Islamic community as a religious and legal authority. They provide guidance on matters of Islamic law and interpret its complexities for the layman. Their rulings and opinions have deep implications for Muslim communities around the world, shaping practices and customs. Muftis also have a diplomatic role in religious discourse and collaboration, working towards bringing Muslims of diverse ethnicities and sects together on issues of common concern.
data.spiritual_significance: The title 'Mufti' is not just a professional identity but rather a calling rooted in deep Islamic scholarship and spiritual commitment. A mufti is expected to possess a profound knowledge of Quran, Hadiths, and other Islamic texts, enabling them to provide guidance that is in accordance with the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Their role as a religious and legal authority provides them the opportunity to interpret Islamic law in ways that nurture and enrich the spiritual lives of their communities. Through their teachings and advisements, they strive to bring Muslims closer to God and help them adhere to the virtuous path laid out by the faith.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mufti serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of jurisconsult.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mufti Maqdisi was a prominent Islamic scholar and theologian in the 14th century. The name Mufti carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mufti Maqdisi was a renowned scholar and jurist in the Islamic world during the Mamluk Sultanate in Egypt.

trends: Mufti is a title given to a Muslim religious leader who is considered an expert in Islamic law.
Muftis provide guidance and advice on Islamic law to individuals and communities.
